note: Reading the board (roadmap 18.10, M10; 17.6 and 17.11). 'teamColors': the colour of each side's ring on the ground and the rim of light round its figures. Enemy options tried on one sheet (15 Nov): white (Suleiman's idea, 11 Nov), red, violet. To try one without changing this file, add ?enemy=white (or red, violet) to the game's address. 'rim': how thick the coloured edge round a figure is, in game pixels, and how strong (0 to 1). 'shadow': the dark under a figure: 'contact' is the small dark patch at the feet, 'floor' the wide soft one that darkens the floor a little. 'tiles': 'fill' is how solid a move or target tile is (lower shows more floor), 'path' the walking line. 15 Nov (Baiyee): the coloured edge round the bodies is OFF (rim alpha 0); the team shows only as a thin soft ring on the floor ('ring': its line width, strength and fill). To try a colour pair add ?rings=tealwhite, tealred or goldred to the address ('ringSets').
